confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than accommodation, since July is peak season in Dublin and rates there vary widely. cocktail and wine_glass are not well anchored, so I set them from beer: cocktail at about 2.1x beer and wine glass at about 1.5x beer. FX: the 2026-10-16 USD per AUD figure (0.6947) comes from the RBA exchange rates page, but I could not open the F11.1 table to confirm it, and it may be provisional.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced against high-cost northwest European capitals with similar summer tourism demand, such as Edinburgh, Amsterdam and Copenhagen, adjusted for Dublin's strong July hotel demand.
